title: 2.5.26 Loop with try/catch
description: Loop over three raw readings and use try/catch to reject bad input with a friendly message instead of crashing. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed — curriculum-plan.md A2.5.1 (loop + try/catch on bad input), informed by Problem Set 2.5.13

steps.title: Loop over three readings
steps.instructions: Write a for loop with i from 1 to 3. Inside, set a variable raw to "12" when i is 1, "abc" when i is 2, and "-4" when i is 3 (three separate if statements).

steps.title: Convert and validate inside try
steps.instructions: Inside a try block, convert raw to a number with Number(raw). If the result is NaN, throw new Error naming the bad value. If it is 0 or less, throw new Error saying it must be positive. Otherwise log the reading number and its value.

steps.title: Report instead of crashing
steps.instructions: In the catch block, log a friendly message using err.message that names which reading was skipped — do not just log a generic "Error!".

requirements.title: for loop present
requirements.description: Code loops over the three readings with a for loop

requirements.title: try/catch inside the loop
requirements.description: The loop body has a try block and a catch block

requirements.title: checks for NaN
requirements.description: Code checks the converted value with Number.isNaN

requirements.title: catch reports err.message
requirements.description: The catch block logs a friendly message that includes err.message, not a generic string
